item.title: Turn Job Alert Emails Into an RSS Feed with Cloudflare Workers
item.description: Job-alert emails pile up quickly and are hard to skim. Each message bundles many listings, and there is no good way to filter or search across them. This is a blueprint for a small pipeline that ingests those emails, extracts the individual listings with an LLM, and serves them as a clean RSS feed and a searchable web dashboard — entirely on Cloudflare’s free tier. It is meant as an idea to replicate, not a ready-made repository.
